caption:
A bakery that doesn’t exist. Yet.

This is a concept project, not a real client. Morgenlaib is a made-up bakery in Munich, a brief I set myself to show how I work.

One message: everything here was baked this morning. The name says it (Morgenlaib is German for “morning loaf”), and the mark shows it: half a loaf rising like the sun, with three cuts. Three colours from the oven: flour, crust and rye. Tested at 64 px, because a mark has to work on a sticker and an avatar.

Opening a bakery or a café? Send me a DM.
